artifacts.summary: Six-phase plan for the books post-task observer: observation-record standard, signal-tagging guide, books-observe.sh live join plus --backfill, fixture test suite, and manifest/index/README/EXTENSION registration.

memory_candidates.content: When an agent-system extension is tasked with building the WRITER for a record consumed by an external repository, check that repository for pre-existing schema/contract documents before designing the schema. Measured case: the books observation record's full vocabulary (seven dimension keys, polarity enum), its repo-side/agent-side field split, its per-field-group provenance marker, and its committed file location were all already specified in the consuming repository's own docs/book-evidence.md plus three books/schema/book-evidence-*-v1.md companions, which explicitly name the agent system's extension as the record's sole writer. Treat such documents as binding design input and conform verbatim (citing them by filename, never by task number) rather than re-deriving a parallel vocabulary that a later cross-repository rollup must reconcile. Corollary for plan decomposition: freeze the schema document as the first phase so every later phase reads field names off one frozen source.
